class="react-directory-commit-message"><a data-pjax="true" title="Release 2.3.0: correct the notify leg against a live notification

The server-to-server notification does not speak the same dialect as the
return URL or queryOrder, and every difference fails the same silent way:
the signature verifies, the payment is genuinely complete, and fulfillment
never runs. No exception, no error, no log line — indistinguishable from a
callback that never arrived.

Fixed:
- trade_status "Completed" now reads as success. The notify leg reports
  Completed where the return URL and queryOrder report PAY_SUCCESS, so
  isPaymentSuccessful() returned false for a verified, paid notification.
  PaymentStatus::isSuccess is the single chokepoint for all three legs.
- parse() unwraps a `data` envelope. Left wrapped, merch_order_id and sign
  are both invisible, so the callback reads as unsigned AND unmatched.
  Only unwrapped when the inner array carries merch_order_id, so a flat
  body with an unrelated `data` key is untouched.

Added:
- NotificationHandler::handle() — parse, unwrap, verify, extract in one
  call, mirroring ReturnUrlHandler::handle(). Fails closed.
- NotificationHandler::unwrap() exposed for step-by-step integrators.
- extractPaymentInfo() returns transId (the id on the customer's SMS
  receipt, previously parsed and discarded), plus merchCode, appId,
  notifyUrl and raw.
- toUnixSeconds() and timestampUnix/notifyTimeUnix. Notify sends epoch
  milliseconds; the return URL sends Y-m-d H:i:s. Non-numeric yields null
  rather than guessing a timezone the strings do not carry.

Signature verification is unchanged: a real notification body verifies
under the existing RSA-PSS path, over a canonical string that includes the
non-standard transId and notify_url fields.

Backward compatible with 2.2.0 — new methods and new array keys only.
23 new tests; 72 passing.

class="react-directory-row-commit-cell"><div><div class="react-directory-commit-message"><a data-pjax="true" title="Release 2.2.0: key normalization, bundled CA, structured errors, getOrderStatus

Ports the integration-feedback roadmap (parity with telebirr-js 3.1.0):

- Auto-normalize bare base64 DER keys (as Ethio Telecom issues them) to PEM
  in Config, detecting PKCS#8/PKCS#1 headers (new KeyNormalizer — previously
  this logic lived only in the examples bootstrap)
- Ship the gateway's CA chain (src/certs/telebirr-ca.pem); CurlHttpClient
  retries against it when system-store verification fails with cURL error 60,
  so TLS works out of the box without verifySsl=false
- ApiException now parses Telebirr's error envelope (getTelebirrCode/
  Message/Solution) and exposes isTransient(); opt-in retry with backoff
- New getOrderStatus() high-level verification helper returning a typed
  OrderStatus value object
- Cache the fabric token until expirationDate within the instance (opt-out),
  invalidate on 401
- Warn on unreachable notifyUrl and verifySsl=false; Config::fromEnvironment
  reads TELEBIRR_* credential env vars (options now optional); new ping()

correct the notify leg against a live notification

The server-to-server notification does not speak the same dialect as the
return URL or queryOrder, and every difference fails the same silent way:
the signature verifies, the payment is genuinely complete, and fulfillment
never runs. No exception, no error, no log line — indistinguishable from a
callback that never arrived.

Fixed:
- trade_status "Completed" now reads as success. The notify leg reports
  Completed where the return URL and queryOrder report PAY_SUCCESS, so
  isPaymentSuccessful() returned false for a verified, paid notification.
  PaymentStatus::isSuccess is the single chokepoint for all three legs.
- parse() unwraps a `data` envelope. Left wrapped, merch_order_id and sign
  are both invisible, so the callback reads as unsigned AND unmatched.
  Only unwrapped when the inner array carries merch_order_id, so a flat
  body with an unrelated `data` key is untouched.

Added:
- NotificationHandler::handle() — parse, unwrap, verify, extract in one
  call, mirroring ReturnUrlHandler::handle(). Fails closed.
- NotificationHandler::unwrap() exposed for step-by-step integrators.
- extractPaymentInfo() returns transId (the id on the customer's SMS
  receipt, previously parsed and discarded), plus merchCode, appId,
  notifyUrl and raw.
- toUnixSeconds() and timestampUnix/notifyTimeUnix. Notify sends epoch
  milliseconds; the return URL sends Y-m-d H:i:s. Non-numeric yields null
  rather than guessing a timezone the strings do not carry.

Signature verification is unchanged: a real notification body verifies
under the existing RSA-PSS path, over a canonical string that includes the
non-standard transId and notify_url fields.

Backward compatible with 2.2.0 — new methods and new array keys only.
23 new tests; 72 passing.

2.2.0: key normalization, bundled CA, structured errors, getOrderStatus

Ports the integration-feedback roadmap (parity with telebirr-js 3.1.0):

- Auto-normalize bare base64 DER keys (as Ethio Telecom issues them) to PEM
  in Config, detecting PKCS#8/PKCS#1 headers (new KeyNormalizer — previously
  this logic lived only in the examples bootstrap)
- Ship the gateway's CA chain (src/certs/telebirr-ca.pem); CurlHttpClient
  retries against it when system-store verification fails with cURL error 60,
  so TLS works out of the box without verifySsl=false
- ApiException now parses Telebirr's error envelope (getTelebirrCode/
  Message/Solution) and exposes isTransient(); opt-in retry with backoff
- New getOrderStatus() high-level verification helper returning a typed
  OrderStatus value object
- Cache the fabric token until expirationDate within the instance (opt-out),
  invalidate on 401
- Warn on unreachable notifyUrl and verifySsl=false; Config::fromEnvironment
  reads TELEBIRR_* credential env vars (options now optional); new ping()
- Update phpseclib 3.0.48 -> 3.0.55 (fixes 4 security advisories incl.
  CVE-2026-32935, CVE-2026-44167)
- Add dependency-free test suite (tests/run.php, composer test) and CHANGELOG

<p dir="auto">A modern PHP library for integrating <strong>Telebirr Web Checkout (C2B)</strong> payments. Telebirr is a mobile money service developed by Huawei and owned by Ethio telecom.</p>
<p dir="auto">This library provides a simple, easy-to-use API for handling Telebirr payments, fully compliant with the <a href="https://developer.ethiotelecom.et/docs/H5%20C2B%20Web%20Payment%20Integration%20Quick%20Guide/requestCreateOrder" rel="nofollow">Telebirr H5 C2B Web Payment Integration Guide</a>.</p>

<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">require</span> <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">vendor/autoload.php</span>'</span>;

<span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Melaku</span>\<span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>\<span class="pl-smi">Config</span>;
<span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Melaku</span>\<span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>\<span class="pl-smi">Telebirr</span>;

<span class="pl-c">// Configure (test environment)</span>
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>config</span> = Config::<span class="pl-en">forTest</span>([
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">fabricAppId</span>'</span>   => <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">YOUR_FABRIC_APP_ID</span>'</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">appSecret</span>'</span>     => <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">YOUR_APP_SECRET</span>'</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">merchantAppId</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">YOUR_MERCHANT_APP_ID</span>'</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">merchantCode</span>'</span>  => <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">YOUR_MERCHANT_CODE</span>'</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">privateKey</span>'</span>    => <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM</span>'</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">notifyUrl</span>'</span>     => <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">https://your-domain.com/telebirr/notify</span>'</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">redirectUrl</span>'</span>   => <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">https://your-domain.com/telebirr/return</span>'</span>,
]);

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span> = <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>config</span>);

<span class="pl-c">// Create checkout URL (one line!). Returns a CheckoutResult.</span>
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>result</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>-><span class="pl-en">createCheckoutUrl</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">Order 123</span>'</span>, <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">100.00</span>'</span>);

<span class="pl-c">// IMPORTANT: persist the EXACT merch_order_id the library used — Telebirr</span>
<span class="pl-c">// echoes this value back in notifications and on the return URL. Storing a</span>
<span class="pl-c">// different value (e.g. one you thought you passed) can cause lookup misses.</span>
<span class="pl-en">saveOrder</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>result</span>-><span class="pl-en">getMerchOrderId</span>(), <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>result</span>-><span class="pl-en">getPrepayId</span>()); <span class="pl-c">// your code</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Redirect customer to Telebirr</span>
<span class="pl-en">header</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">Location: </span>'</span> . <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>result</span>-><span class="pl-en">getCheckoutUrl</span>());
<span class="pl-k">exit</span>;</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="require 'vendor/autoload.php';

use Melaku\Telebirr\Config;
use Melaku\Telebirr\Telebirr;

// Configure (test environment)
$config = Config::forTest([
    'fabricAppId'   => 'YOUR_FABRIC_APP_ID',
    'appSecret'     => 'YOUR_APP_SECRET',
    'merchantAppId' => 'YOUR_MERCHANT_APP_ID',
    'merchantCode'  => 'YOUR_MERCHANT_CODE',
    'privateKey'    => 'YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM',
    'notifyUrl'     => 'https://your-domain.com/telebirr/notify',
    'redirectUrl'   => 'https://your-domain.com/telebirr/return',
]);

$client = new Telebirr($config);

// Create checkout URL (one line!). Returns a CheckoutResult.
$result = $client->createCheckoutUrl('Order 123', '100.00');

<p dir="auto">That's it! The library handles token management, order creation, and checkout URL generation automatically.</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Merchant order id charset:</strong> a merch_order_id must match <code>^[A-Za-z0-9]+$</code>
(ASCII letters and digits only — no <code>-</code>, <code>_</code>, <code>.</code> or spaces). Invalid ids now
throw an <code>InvalidParameterException</code> instead of being silently rewritten. Pass
<code>null</code> to have a valid id generated for you, and read it back from the result.</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">In-App SDK Payment</h3><a id="user-content-in-app-sdk-payment" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: In-App SDK Payment" href="#in-app-sdk-payment"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">If your mobile app's Telebirr SDK initiates the payment instead of a browser
redirect, use <code>createInAppOrder()</code>. There's no checkout URL for this flow — the
response's <code>receiveCode</code> must be passed to the mobile SDK to continue the payment.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>tokenInfo</span>   = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>-><span class="pl-en">applyFabricToken</span>();
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>fabricToken</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>tokenInfo</span>[<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">token</span>'</span>];

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>order</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>-><span class="pl-en">createInAppOrder</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>fabricToken</span>, <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">Order 123</span>'</span>, <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">100.00</span>'</span>);
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>receiveCode</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>order</span>[<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">biz_content</span>'</span>][<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">receiveCode</span>'</span>];

<span class="pl-c">// Send the receiveCode to your mobile app for the SDK to complete the payment.</span>
<span class="pl-en">header</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">Content-Type: application/json</span>'</span>);
<span class="pl-k">echo</span> <span class="pl-en">json_encode</span>([<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">receiveCode</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>receiveCode</span>]);</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

$fabricToken = $tokenInfo['token'];

<p dir="auto">You'll receive these from Telebirr:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>fabricAppId</code> - Your Fabric App ID (UUID)</li>
<li><code>appSecret</code> - Your App Secret</li>
<li><code>merchantAppId</code> - Your Merchant App ID</li>
<li><code>merchantCode</code> - Your Merchant Code (6-digit)</li>
<li><code>privateKey</code> - Your RSA Private Key</li>
<li><code>notifyUrl</code> - Server-to-server notification URL (required)</li>
<li><code>redirectUrl</code> - User return URL after payment (optional)</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Key formats — bare base64 is fine</h3><a id="user-content-key-formats--bare-base64-is-fine" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Key formats — bare base64 is fine" href="#key-formats--bare-base64-is-fine"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Ethio Telecom issues merchant keys as <strong>bare base64 DER</strong> (a single long
<code>MIIEvgIBADANBgk…</code> line, no <code>-----BEGIN…-----</code> armor). Pass it exactly as
issued — the library normalizes it to PEM automatically, picking the right
header (PKCS#8 vs PKCS#1) for you. Proper PEM works too, including PEM whose
newlines were flattened to literal <code>\n</code> by a <code>.env</code> file.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">💡 Key Features</h2><a id="user-content--key-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 💡 Key Features" href="#-key-features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>✅ <strong>Simple API</strong> - One-call checkout (<code>createCheckoutUrl</code>) and one-call verification (<code>getOrderStatus</code>)</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Automatic Token Management</strong> - Fabric tokens are fetched, cached until expiry, and refreshed for you</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Key normalization</strong> - Bare base64 keys (as Ethio Telecom issues them) or PEM, both just work</li>
<li>✅ <strong>TLS that just works</strong> - Falls back to a bundled Telebirr CA chain when the test gateway's incomplete chain fails the system store; no <code>verifySsl => false</code> needed</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Structured errors + opt-in retry</strong> - Branch on <code>$e->getTelebirrCode()</code>; retry transient sandbox errors with backoff</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Signature Verification</strong> - Built-in helpers for return URLs and notifications</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Helper Classes</strong> - <code>ReturnUrlHandler</code>, <code>NotificationHandler</code>, <code>PaymentStatus</code></li>
<li>✅ <strong>Environment Support</strong> - Automatic test/production URL handling</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Full Compliance</strong> - Follows Telebirr H5 C2B Web Payment Integration spec</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">📖 Common Use Cases</h2><a id="user-content--common-use-cases" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 📖 Common Use Cases" href="#-common-use-cases"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Verify a payment (<code>getOrderStatus</code>)</h3><a id="user-content-verify-a-payment-getorderstatus" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Verify a payment (getOrderStatus)" href="#verify-a-payment-getorderstatus"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The one-call, server-to-server way to confirm what actually happened to an
order — the verification counterpart to <code>createCheckoutUrl</code>. Token handling
and response mapping are done for you:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>-><span class="pl-en">getOrderStatus</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">YOUR_MERCH_ORDER_ID</span>'</span>);

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">paid</span>;           <span class="pl-c">// bool — true ONLY on an explicit success status (fails closed)</span>
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">tradeStatus</span>;    <span class="pl-c">// e.g. 'PAY_SUCCESS'</span>
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">amount</span>;         <span class="pl-c">// e.g. '100.00' — VERIFY this against your own order amount</span>
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">currency</span>;       <span class="pl-c">// 'ETB'</span>
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">paymentOrderId</span>; <span class="pl-c">// Telebirr's transaction reference (or null)</span>
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">raw</span>;            <span class="pl-c">// the full queryOrder response if you need more</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Handle Payment Return</h3><a id="user-content-handle-payment-return" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Handle Payment Return" href="#handle-payment-return"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Melaku</span>\<span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>\<span class="pl-smi">ReturnUrlHandler</span>;

<span class="pl-k">try</span> {
    <span class="pl-c">// Fails closed: throws if the signature is missing or invalid.</span>
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>paymentData</span> = ReturnUrlHandler::<span class="pl-en">handle</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span><span class="pl-c1">_GET</span></span>, <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>config</span>);

    <span class="pl-k">if</span> (<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>paymentData</span>[<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">isSuccess</span>'</span>]) {
        <span class="pl-c">// The return URL comes through the user's browser and is spoofable even</span>
        <span class="pl-c">// when signed. For anything that fulfils an order, confirm the real</span>
        <span class="pl-c">// status server-to-server before acting on it:</span>
        <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>-><span class="pl-en">getOrderStatus</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>paymentData</span>[<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">merchantOrderId</span>'</span>]);
        <span class="pl-k">if</span> (<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">paid</span> && <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">amount</span> === <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>expectedAmount</span>) {
            <span class="pl-c">// Update your database / fulfill the order — idempotently (see below).</span>
        }
    }
} <span class="pl-k">catch</span> (<span class="pl-smi">\<span class="pl-smi">RuntimeException</span></span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>) {
    <span class="pl-c">// Missing/invalid signature</span>
    <span class="pl-en">http_response_code</span>(<span class="pl-c1">400</span>);
    <span class="pl-k">echo</span> <span class="pl-s">"<span class="pl-s">Invalid payment data</span>"</span>;
}</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="use Melaku\Telebirr\ReturnUrlHandler;

try {
    // Fails closed: throws if the signature is missing or invalid.
    $paymentData = ReturnUrlHandler::handle($_GET, $config);

    if ($paymentData['isSuccess']) {
        // The return URL comes through the user's browser and is spoofable even
        // when signed. For anything that fulfils an order, confirm the real
        // status server-to-server before acting on it:
        $status = $client->getOrderStatus($paymentData['merchantOrderId']);
        if ($status->paid && $status->amount === $expectedAmount) {
            // Update your database / fulfill the order — idempotently (see below).
        }
    }
} catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
    // Missing/invalid signature
    http_response_code(400);
    echo "Invalid payment data";
}" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Return-URL parameters (the raw contract)</h4><a id="user-content-return-url-parameters-the-raw-contract" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Return-URL parameters (the raw contract)" href="#return-url-parameters-the-raw-contract"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Telebirr redirects the user's browser to your <code>redirectUrl</code> with these query
parameters appended (snake_case):</p>
<markdown-accessiblity-table data-catalyst=""><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Parameter</th>
<th>Meaning</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>merch_order_id</code></td>
<td>Your merchant order id, echoed back verbatim</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>payment_order_id</code></td>
<td>Telebirr's transaction reference</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>trade_status</code></td>
<td>e.g. <code>PAY_SUCCESS</code>, <code>PAY_FAILED</code>, <code>PAY_CANCEL</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>total_amount</code></td>
<td>Order amount</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>trans_currency</code></td>
<td>Currency (<code>ETB</code>)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>trans_end_time</code></td>
<td>Transaction end time</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>sign</code>, <code>sign_type</code></td>
<td>RSA-PSS signature over the other params</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<p dir="auto"><code>ReturnUrlHandler::handle()</code> verifies the signature and maps these for you —
the table is here for when you're debugging the raw redirect.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">The idempotent settlement pattern (recommended)</h3><a id="user-content-the-idempotent-settlement-pattern-recommended" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: The idempotent settlement pattern (recommended)" href="#the-idempotent-settlement-pattern-recommended"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The browser return and the server notification <strong>race</strong> — either can arrive
first, both can arrive, and neither should be trusted on its own. The
production-correct shape:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>On checkout, store a row keyed by <code>merchOrderId</code> with <code>status='pending'</code>
and the expected <code>amount</code>.</li>
<li>On <strong>both</strong> the return handler and the notify handler, call
<code>$client->getOrderStatus($merchOrderId)</code> — never trust the callback params.</li>
<li>Verify <code>$status->paid === true</code> <strong>and</strong> <code>$status->amount</code> matches your
stored amount.</li>
<li>Grant idempotently with a compare-and-set, so the racing paths can't
double-fulfill:</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">function</span> <span class="pl-en">settle</span>(<span class="pl-smi"><span class="pl-smi">Telebirr</span></span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>, <span class="pl-c1"><span class="pl-smi"><span class="pl-smi">PDO</span></span></span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>db</span>, <span class="pl-smi">string</span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>merchOrderId</span>): <span class="pl-smi">void</span>
{
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>-><span class="pl-en">getOrderStatus</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>merchOrderId</span>);
    <span class="pl-k">if</span> (!<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">paid</span>) {
        <span class="pl-k">return</span>;
    }

    <span class="pl-c">// Atomic claim: only one caller flips pending → success.</span>
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>stmt</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>db</span>-><span class="pl-en">prepare</span>(
        <span class="pl-s">"<span class="pl-s">UPDATE orders SET status = 'success'</span></span>
<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-s">         WHERE merch_order_id = :id AND status = 'pending' AND amount = :amount</span>"</span>
    );
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>stmt</span>-><span class="pl-en">execute</span>([<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">id</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>merchOrderId</span>, <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">amount</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">amount</span>]);

    <span class="pl-k">if</span> (<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>stmt</span>-><span class="pl-en">rowCount</span>() === <span class="pl-c1">1</span>) {
        <span class="pl-en">fulfillOrder</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>merchOrderId</span>); <span class="pl-c">// runs exactly once</span>
    }
}</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="function settle(Telebirr $client, PDO $db, string $merchOrderId): void
{
    $status = $client->getOrderStatus($merchOrderId);
    if (!$status->paid) {
        return;
    }

    // Atomic claim: only one caller flips pending → success.
    $stmt = $db->prepare(
        "UPDATE orders SET status = 'success'
         WHERE merch_order_id = :id AND status = 'pending' AND amount = :amount"
    );
    $stmt->execute(['id' => $merchOrderId, 'amount' => $status->amount]);

    if ($stmt->rowCount() === 1) {
        fulfillOrder($merchOrderId); // runs exactly once
    }
}" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Notification acknowledgement contract</h4><a id="user-content-notification-acknowledgement-contract" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Notification acknowledgement contract" href="#notification-acknowledgement-contract"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Telebirr POSTs the notification as a JSON body to your <code>notifyUrl</code>.</li>
<li>Acknowledge success with <strong>HTTP 200</strong> and a JSON body — this is what
<code>NotificationHandler::respondSuccess()</code> emits: <code>{"success": true}</code>.</li>
<li>Any non-2xx status tells Telebirr the delivery failed; it will <strong>retry the
notification</strong> later. Respond 200 once you have durably recorded the event,
and reserve error responses for "I could not record this, please retry".</li>
<li>Your <code>notifyUrl</code> must be publicly reachable — <code>localhost</code> or a private
address will never receive anything (the library warns about this at
construction time). In development use a tunnel (ngrok, cloudflared).</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Handle Payment Notifications</h3><a id="user-content-handle-payment-notifications" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Handle Payment Notifications" href="#handle-payment-notifications"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><code>NotificationHandler::handle()</code> is the recommended entry point — it parses,
unwraps, verifies and extracts in one call, and <strong>fails closed</strong> by throwing on a
missing or invalid signature.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Melaku</span>\<span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>\<span class="pl-smi">NotificationHandler</span>;
<span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Melaku</span>\<span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>\<span class="pl-v">Exceptions</span>\<span class="pl-smi">TelebirrException</span>;

<span class="pl-k">try</span> {
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>payment</span> = NotificationHandler::<span class="pl-en">handle</span>(<span class="pl-en">file_get_contents</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">php://input</span>'</span>), <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>config</span>);
} <span class="pl-k">catch</span> (<span class="pl-smi"><span class="pl-smi">TelebirrException</span></span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>) {
    <span class="pl-c">// respond* RETURN a NotificationResponse (no header()/echo). In a</span>
    <span class="pl-c">// framework, convert it to your Response object. In bare PHP, call send().</span>
    NotificationHandler::<span class="pl-en">respondError</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">Invalid signature</span>'</span>, <span class="pl-c1">401</span>)-><span class="pl-en">send</span>();
    <span class="pl-k">exit</span>;
}

<span class="pl-k">if</span> (<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>payment</span>[<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">isSuccess</span>'</span>]) {
    <span class="pl-c">// Confirm server-to-server before fulfilling — see the settlement pattern above.</span>
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span> = <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>-><span class="pl-en">getOrderStatus</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>payment</span>[<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">merchantOrderId</span>'</span>]);
    <span class="pl-k">if</span> (<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">paid</span> && <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>status</span>-><span class="pl-c1">amount</span> === <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>expectedAmount</span>) {
        <span class="pl-c">// Update database, fulfill order, etc. — idempotently.</span>
    }
}

NotificationHandler::<span class="pl-en">respondSuccess</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">Payment processed</span>'</span>)-><span class="pl-en">send</span>();</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="use Melaku\Telebirr\NotificationHandler;
use Melaku\Telebirr\Exceptions\TelebirrException;

try {
    $payment = NotificationHandler::handle(file_get_contents('php://input'), $config);

    // respond* RETURN a NotificationResponse (no header()/echo). In a
    // framework, convert it to your Response object. In bare PHP, call send().
    NotificationHandler::respondError('Invalid signature', 401)->send();
    exit;

    // Confirm server-to-server before fulfilling — see the settlement pattern above.
    $status = $client->getOrderStatus($payment['merchantOrderId']);
    if ($status->paid && $status->amount === $expectedAmount) {
        // Update database, fulfill order, etc. — idempotently.
    }
}

NotificationHandler::respondSuccess('Payment processed')->send();" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto">The lower-level <code>parse()</code> / <code>verify()</code> / <code>isPaymentSuccessful()</code> /
<code>extractPaymentInfo()</code> calls remain available and unchanged if you need the steps
separately.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Notify parameters (the raw contract)</h4><a id="user-content-notify-parameters-the-raw-contract" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Notify parameters (the raw contract)" href="#notify-parameters-the-raw-contract"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Telebirr POSTs a JSON body to your <code>notifyUrl</code>. <strong>It does not use the same
conventions as the return URL</strong> — the differences below are handled for you, but
they are the reason a hand-rolled notify handler tends to fail silently.</p>
<markdown-accessiblity-table data-catalyst=""><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Parameter</th>
<th>Meaning</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>merch_order_id</code></td>
<td>Your merchant order id, echoed back verbatim</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>payment_order_id</code></td>
<td>Telebirr's transaction reference</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>transId</code></td>
<td>Short transaction id — the one on the customer's SMS receipt</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>trade_status</code></td>
<td><strong><code>Completed</code></strong> — <em>not</em> <code>PAY_SUCCESS</code> as on the return leg</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>total_amount</code></td>
<td>Order amount</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>trans_currency</code></td>
<td>Currency (<code>ETB</code>)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>trans_end_time</code>, <code>notify_time</code></td>
<td>Epoch <strong>milliseconds</strong> — the return URL sends <code>Y-m-d H:i:s</code> strings instead</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>merch_code</code>, <code>appid</code>, <code>notify_url</code></td>
<td>Echoed back; part of the signed payload, so they must be kept when verifying</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>sign</code>, <code>sign_type</code></td>
<td>RSA-PSS signature over the other params</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<p dir="auto">Three consequences, all handled by <code>handle()</code>:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong><code>Completed</code> is the success word on this leg.</strong> <code>PaymentStatus::isSuccess()</code>
accepts it. A handler that only checks <code>PAY_SUCCESS</code> will verify a genuine
payment and then silently skip fulfillment — no error, no log line.</li>
<li><strong>The body is sometimes wrapped in a <code>data</code> envelope.</strong> <code>parse()</code> unwraps it.
Left wrapped, both the order id and the signature are invisible, so the
callback reads as unsigned <em>and</em> unmatched.</li>
<li><strong>Timestamps are milliseconds.</strong> <code>extractPaymentInfo()</code> returns the raw values
under <code>timestamp</code> / <code>notifyTime</code> and normalized Unix seconds under
<code>timestampUnix</code> / <code>notifyTimeUnix</code> (null for the return leg's formatted
strings, which carry no timezone worth guessing at).</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Framework usage:</strong> instead of <code>->send()</code>, build a native response, e.g. in
Laravel: <code>return response(json: $resp->getBody(), status: $resp->getStatusCode());</code></p>
</blockquote>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>PHP >= 7.4</li>
<li><code>ext-curl</code> extension</li>
<li><code>ext-openssl</code> extension (used by the legacy <code>Notify</code> class for payload decryption only)</li>
<li><strong>phpseclib/phpseclib</strong> (^3.0) — <strong>Signer</strong> and <strong>SignatureVerifier</strong> use phpseclib only (pure-PHP). No OpenSSL CLI or ext-openssl required for signing/verification. Works on all platforms including Windows. Algorithm: RSA-PSS, SHA256, MGF1-SHA256, salt length 32.</li>
<li><strong>psr/log</strong> (^1.1 || ^2.0 || ^3.0) — the library type-hints the standard <code>Psr\Log\LoggerInterface</code>, so any PSR-3 logger (Monolog, Laravel's logger, …) drops straight in.</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">The default HTTP client verifies the gateway's TLS certificate and applies
timeouts (a payment gateway must not be called over an unverified or unbounded
connection).</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>The Telebirr test gateway serves an incomplete certificate chain</strong> (leaf
only, missing intermediate), which used to fail verification with cURL error
60 and push people toward <code>'verifySsl' => false</code>. The library now <strong>ships the
gateway's CA chain</strong> (<code>src/certs/telebirr-ca.pem</code>): when system-store
verification fails with error 60 and no custom bundle was supplied, the
request is retried once against the bundled chain — so verification works out
of the box. The bundled chain can only validate hosts issued under it (the
Telebirr gateways); it never loosens verification for anything else. If
verification still fails, the error explains the options.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>config</span> = Config::<span class="pl-en">forProduction</span>([
    <span class="pl-c">// ... credentials ...</span>
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">verifySsl</span>'</span>      => <span class="pl-c1">true</span>,   <span class="pl-c">// default true — leave on; the library warns (test) or</span>
                                 <span class="pl-c">// logs an error (production) if you turn it off</span>
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">caBundlePath</span>'</span>   => <span class="pl-c1">null</span>,   <span class="pl-c">// optional path to a custom CA bundle (PEM);</span>
                                 <span class="pl-c">// supplying one disables the bundled-CA fallback</span>
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">timeout</span>'</span>        => <span class="pl-c1">30</span>,     <span class="pl-c">// total request timeout (seconds)</span>
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">connectTimeout</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-c1">10</span>,     <span class="pl-c">// connection timeout (seconds)</span>
]);</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

    // ... credentials ...

    'connectTimeout' => 10,     // connection timeout (seconds)

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Token caching</h3><a id="user-content-token-caching" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Token caching" href="#token-caching"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><code>createCheckoutUrl()</code> and <code>getOrderStatus()</code> cache the fabric token until its
<code>expirationDate</code> (minus a 60s safety margin) <strong>within the client instance</strong>
and reuse it, saving a gateway round-trip whenever one request performs
several calls (e.g. a settle path). A rejected token (HTTP 401) drops the
cache automatically. Note PHP's request lifecycle: the cache does not persist
across requests. Opt out for strictly stateless behavior:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span> = <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>config</span>, <span class="pl-c1">null</span>, <span class="pl-c1">null</span>, [<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">cacheFabricToken</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-c1">false</span>]);</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<p dir="auto"><code>applyFabricToken()</code> always performs a real network call (and refreshes the
cache), so existing manual flows are unaffected.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Retrying transient gateway errors</h3><a id="user-content-retrying-transient-gateway-errors" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Retrying transient gateway errors" href="#retrying-transient-gateway-errors"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The test gateway regularly throws transient infra errors (see the sandbox
note below). Retry is <strong>opt-in</strong> with exponential backoff:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span> = <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>config</span>, <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>logger</span>, <span class="pl-c1">null</span>, [
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">retry</span>'</span> => [<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">retries</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-c1">2</span>, <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">delayMs</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-c1">500</span>, <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">maxDelayMs</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-c1">5000</span>],
]);</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<p dir="auto">Only failures where <code>ApiException::isTransient()</code> is true are retried: known
Telebirr infra codes (<code>49401024991</code> "southbound service unavailable"),
HTTP 502/503/504, and cURL timeouts/connection drops. Parameter or auth
errors fail immediately. The code list is
<code>ApiException::TRANSIENT_TELEBIRR_ERROR_CODES</code>.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Injecting a custom HTTP client (testing)</h3><a id="user-content-injecting-a-custom-http-client-testing" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Injecting a custom HTTP client (testing)" href="#injecting-a-custom-http-client-testing"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The third constructor argument accepts any <code>Melaku\Telebirr\Http\HttpClientInterface</code>,
so you can unit-test without hitting the network:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Melaku</span>\<span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>\<span class="pl-v">Http</span>\<span class="pl-smi">HttpClientInterface</span>;
<span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Melaku</span>\<span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>\<span class="pl-v">Http</span>\<span class="pl-smi">HttpResponse</span>;

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>fake</span> = <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-k">class</span> <span class="pl-k">implements</span> HttpClientInterface {
    <span class="pl-k">public</span> <span class="pl-k">function</span> <span class="pl-en">post</span>(<span class="pl-smi">string</span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>url</span>, <span class="pl-smi">array</span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>headers</span>, <span class="pl-smi">string</span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>body</span>): <span class="pl-smi"><span class="pl-smi">HttpResponse</span></span> {
        <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-v">HttpResponse</span>(<span class="pl-c1">200</span>, <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">{"token":"Bearer TEST"}</span>'</span>);
    }
};

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span> = <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>config</span>, <span class="pl-c1">null</span>, <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>fake</span>);</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Catching errors</h3><a id="user-content-catching-errors" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Catching errors" href="#catching-errors"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Every exception the library throws implements
<code>Melaku\Telebirr\Exceptions\TelebirrExceptionInterface</code>, so you can catch them
all in one place. API failures throw <code>ApiException</code>, which now carries
Telebirr's parsed error envelope — no more <code>json_decode($e->getResponseBody())</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Melaku</span>\<span class="pl-v">Telebirr</span>\<span class="pl-v">Exceptions</span>\<span class="pl-smi">ApiException</span>;

<span class="pl-k">try</span> {
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>client</span>-><span class="pl-en">createCheckoutUrl</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">Order 123</span>'</span>, <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">100.00</span>'</span>);
} <span class="pl-k">catch</span> (<span class="pl-smi"><span class="pl-smi">ApiException</span></span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>) {
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>-><span class="pl-en">getHttpStatus</span>();       <span class="pl-c">// e.g. 400</span>
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>-><span class="pl-en">getTelebirrCode</span>();     <span class="pl-c">// e.g. '49401024991' — parsed from the body</span>
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>-><span class="pl-en">getTelebirrMessage</span>();  <span class="pl-c">// Telebirr's errorMsg</span>
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>-><span class="pl-en">getTelebirrSolution</span>(); <span class="pl-c">// Telebirr's errorSolution remediation text</span>
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>-><span class="pl-en">isTransient</span>();         <span class="pl-c">// true for retryable gateway-side failures</span>
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>e</span>-><span class="pl-en">getResponseBody</span>();     <span class="pl-c">// raw body, if you need it</span>
}</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="use Melaku\Telebirr\Exceptions\ApiException;

try {
    $client->createCheckoutUrl('Order 123', '100.00');
} catch (ApiException $e) {
    $e->getHttpStatus();       // e.g. 400
    $e->getTelebirrCode();     // e.g. '49401024991' — parsed from the body
    $e->getTelebirrMessage();  // Telebirr's errorMsg
    $e->getTelebirrSolution(); // Telebirr's errorSolution remediation text
    $e->isTransient();         // true for retryable gateway-side failures
    $e->getResponseBody();     // raw body, if you need it

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Amounts & rounding</h3><a id="user-content-amounts--rounding" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Amounts & rounding" href="#amounts--rounding"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><code>amount</code> accepts <code>string|int|float</code> and is formatted to exactly 2 decimals —
Telebirr's wire format for ETB. If you store amounts in minor units (cents),
divide before passing (<code>$cents / 100</code>). Prefer passing a <strong>string</strong>
(<code>'100.50'</code>) when the value came from user input or a DB decimal column,
sidestepping binary floating-point surprises.</p>

<p dir="auto">If your request worked before and suddenly throws a <code>4940…</code> code with an
<code>errorSolution</code> suggesting a retry, <strong>it's the gateway, not your code</strong>.
Wait and retry (or enable the <code>retry</code> option above). Don't spend an hour
debugging a correct integration.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🔒 Security Notes</h2><a id="user-content--security-notes" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🔒 Security Notes" href="#-security-notes"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Always verify signatures before processing payments</li>
<li>Use HTTPS for all payment endpoints</li>
<li>Store credentials in environment variables, not in code</li>
<li>Implement idempotency checks for notifications</li>
<li>Never trust return URL parameters alone - verify with server-to-server notifications</li>
</ul>
